author: Aren H.
title: Not For Me!!!
content: I've been looking for "quality" no-show socks for a while that were also "white" since I've bought many before and they all ended up with holes in no time at all, I bought 3 top selling brands, Wander, ZeroPoker and Closemate and thought I'd help others before they pulled the trigger. (mind you I'm typically NOT an online apparel buying type-a-guy) but socks? What could go wrong? Well, a lot! But here are images and TRUE reviews. Wander: Probably my top choice for quality, it's thick and well made, isn't paper-thin (although some of you might be looking for that, which is fine) but Wander is and feels like a standard sock, it's no-show but has feel of a sock. Only gripe I have, it's not white-white but good enough. ZeroPoker: Top choice for whiteness, I mean they're pure white and the quality is great, not as thick as Wander and the feel is good, not great comparatively but you'll enjoy them for sure. My day to day because it's overall my top-pick. CloseMate: I've just got nothing for ya, sorry. Socks came stained from the black paper wrapping they're in, the sock is ULTRA thin, I feel stretching them twice to wear would demolition them (instant hole) and they're YELLOW!!! (IMAGE does no justice) I mean if you want thin and like that shade of yellow it's a great sock (I guess). I'll pass personally but gave 2 stars as some might like ultra thin and yellow.
